# OpenSubtitles fixtures

Synthetic responses shaped after the official OpenAPI specification (`https://opensubtitles.stoplight.io/api/v1/projects/opensubtitles/opensubtitles-api/nodes/open_api.json`, fetched 2026-10-15): `POST /login` (`token`, `base_url`, `user.allowed_downloads`), `GET /subtitles` (`data[].attributes` with `language`, `release`, `hearing_impaired`, `foreign_parts_only`, `download_count`, `ratings`, `files[].file_id`, `feature_details`; `moviehash_match` only for a query with `moviehash`), `POST /download` (`link`, `file_name`, `remaining`, `reset_time_utc`). Release names and IDs are made up. Live responses (once an account is in `.env`) go to the git-ignored `live/` folder.
